faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We answer the most common questions so you can get started with TikNEO with complete peace of mind.

items.question: How does the trial period work?
items.answer: To start your free trial, all you have to do is sign up for TikNEO and confirm your email address. Once your trial begins, you can try every feature, with no limits.

items.question: Which features are included in the trial period?
items.answer: During the trial you have access to all TikNEO features: clock-in management, shifts, workforce reports, multi-company, projects, notices and chat, and the rest of the tools in the plan. No limits, so you can evaluate the platform with your team.

items.question: What happens if my company grows and I need to invite more employees?
items.answer: TikNEO adapts to the size of your company. You can invite more employees whenever you need and upgrade your plan at any time from the settings. Prices adjust transparently according to the number of users.

items.question: Do I have to enter my credit card to start my trial period?
items.answer: No. You can start your free trial without entering a credit card or any other payment method. You only need to sign up and confirm your email address.

items.question: Are the prices tax free?
items.answer: The prices shown may not include taxes depending on your country or type of invoicing. When you sign up for a plan, you will see the final breakdown based on your location and whether VAT or other taxes apply.

items.question: What happens when my trial period ends?
items.answer: When your trial period ends, you can choose a paid plan to keep using TikNEO. Your data, settings and keys are stored securely so you can carry on without losing anything.

items.question: Which payment methods can I use?
items.answer: We accept credit and debit cards and, subject to availability, bank transfer and other local methods. You can manage and change your payment method at any time from your account settings.

items.question: Will my data be safe?
items.answer: At TikNEO, the security of our users is what matters most. That is why we protect all your information with a powerful encryption system. You can read more in our

items.question: How can I upgrade my plan?
items.answer: To move from your free trial account to one of our plans, go to the billing or settings section of your account. You can change or upgrade your plan at any time and the change applies immediately.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.answer: Yes, and once cancelled, your subscription will not renew again. Even so, you can keep using TikNEO until the next renewal date.

items.question: I have more questions
items.answer: If you have more questions, get in touch with us — we're looking forward to helping you.

privacy.metaDescription: TikNEO privacy and data protection policy.

blocks.text: Tikneo, with registered address at Plaza Ferrerias 19, Office 1, Donostia, Spain, postcode 20011, is the controller of the personal data collected through this website and the TikNEO platform. Contact: info@tikneo.com.

We process the data you provide through the forms on the site (first name, surname, email, phone, company, role and sector), as well as the data needed to provide the service to client companies (employee data, clock-ins, shifts and absences).

We use your data to handle requests for information or a demo (consent), to provide the contracted service (performance of a contract) and to comply with applicable legal obligations, such as the working-time record set out in Spanish Royal Decree-Law 8/2019.
We keep the data for as long as a contractual relationship exists or until you request its deletion, and afterwards for the periods required by applicable regulations.
We do not share data with third parties except where legally required or with providers acting as data processors (hosting, communications), with whom we have the contracts required by the GDPR.
We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures, including encryption of information, role-based access control and automatic backups.

You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to info@tikneo.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

terms.metaDescription: General terms and conditions of the TikNEO service.

blocks.text: TikNEO (hereinafter, “the Service”) is a time tracking and staff management platform operated by Tikneo, with registered address at Plaza Ferrerias 19, Office 1, Donostia, Spain, postcode 20011. Contact: info@tikneo.com.
These terms govern the contracting and use of the Service by client companies. Signing up for any of the plans implies full acceptance of these terms.

The prices in force for each plan are those published on the plans and pricing page. Unless expressly stated, prices do not include applicable taxes. Billing is monthly and the amount depends on the plan contracted and the number of active employees.
TikNEO offers a free trial period with no need to enter a card. Once the trial period ends, access to the features is subject to signing up for a plan.
The client may cancel their subscription at any time from their account settings. Cancellation prevents the next renewal, and access is kept until the end of the period already invoiced.
The client undertakes to make lawful use of the Service, to safeguard their access credentials and to ensure that they have a legal basis for processing their employees' data within the platform.
